rp2sp.basis: absolute cuts on this direction's own FIT scale, not per-build quantiles (a quantile tier moves a pitcher when the pool moves, not when he does). The two directions are different 0-100 scales and are never compared across the tab.

sp2rp.basis: absolute cuts on this direction's own FIT scale, not per-build quantiles (a quantile tier moves a pitcher when the pool moves, not when he does). The two directions are different 0-100 scales and are never compared across the tab.

severity_cuts.label: a full swing band past the boundary
three quarters of the band past the boundary
half the band past the boundary, the listing floor

prospect_watch_rule.basis: severity = shape points past the SWING band [40, 60]; threshold is half the band width, an a-priori structural bound, not a fitted one

war_basis.series: eWAR v2: the Baseball-Reference run frame with pitching re-priced on FIP within role (fielding unchanged pending SDR; position players match bWAR except in seasons they also pitched)
war_basis.source: war_source.stint_frame('pit', provider='ewar_v2'), the displayed WAR (owner answer EPOCH-Q4)

gate.basis_series: bWAR: the Baseball-Reference run frame, pitchers priced on the runs they actually allowed
gate.rule: rho(FIT,war_delta) >= rho(best baseline) AND gap lo95 > -0.01
gate.note: Carried from the eval artifact, never re-run here. A direction with pass=false ships as a structural screen: its FIT ordering is not validated against realized WAR change.

backtest.primary_outcome: war_delta (post-season minus pre-season on the war_basis series stamped below), per direction, closed post seasons only; the pooled held rho above is a legacy reporting field (two different 0-100 scales)
backtest.disclaimer: A screen, not a success-probability model. The conversion sample is small and selection-biased (only pitchers teams chose to convert), so the weights are frozen priors from the literature. The gated evaluation (per-direction rho vs same-event baselines, bootstrap CI) is data/pal_eval.json; the rhos here are the live stamp of the same repaired backtest code. Held labels read closed >=20 IP follow-up seasons only. WAR outcomes are on eWAR v2: the Baseball-Reference run frame with pitching re-priced on FIP within role (fielding unchanged pending SDR; position players match bWAR except in seasons they also pitched), stamped 2026-10-03. The pre-registered gate (data/pal_eval.json, 2026-07-15) ran on bWAR: the Baseball-Reference run frame, pitchers priced on the runs they actually allowed. It has NOT been re-run on the series above, so the rhos and the verdicts beside them are not the same measurement.
